profile.org_note: Four divisions (Coastal Virginia, Raleigh/Triangle, Coastal North Carolina, Coastal South Carolina) run from Virginia Beach. A 2025 Myrtle Beach Division Manager posting reported to a Vice President of Production, and divisions are led by division managers rather than published division presidents. Land is sourced and developed largely through sister company Wakefield Development (also owned by L.M. Sandler & Sons), whose team handles land acquisition, project finance and land development. The owners, Steve and Art Sandler, sit above both companies. In March 2026 Chesapeake Homes advertised a new Mid-Atlantic Land Acquisition Executive seat, covering VA, NC and nearby markets; the hire is not public.
profile.summary: Family-owned regional for-sale builder (2026 Builder 100 rank 90: 631 closings, about $308M revenue in 2025, including 110 single-family build-to-rent units), owned by the Sandler family's L.M. Sandler & Sons, Inc. It builds entry-level, move-up, active-adult and second-home product in Hampton Roads, Raleigh, coastal NC (Leland/Calabash) and the Myrtle Beach Grand Strand. It is a vertically integrated family platform: lots come largely from sister developer Wakefield Development, and the family also owns title, mortgage and realty businesses. The preferred mortgage lender on the company site is Atlantic Coast Mortgage. Mainly a conventional for-sale homebuilder and a plausible but unproven land-banking prospect: it uses option and JV structures, but the family's long-standing bank and equity partners fund land today.
